title: Teller and Sakharov meet; Sakharov says Teller was right

tellings.quote: And later Teller and Sakharov actually got to meet. And Sakharov, the father of the Russian hydrogen bomb, looked at all of Teller's communications back and forth and said, "Oh, Teller was right.

plain: The physicist Edward Teller, a father of the American hydrogen bomb, and Andrei Sakharov, the father of the Soviet one, later met, and Sakharov looked over Teller's exchanges and said that Teller had been right. The physicist John Brandenburg tells Michels this as something he repeats from what was said, without saying what exactly Teller was right about.
